Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search snippet and prematurely concluded the answer without verification, incorrectly stating that Stefan Nemanja died at Studenica Monastery “in Mount Athos” and even giving the wrong year (1196). In reality, Anastasia’s husband, Stefan Nemanja, died at Hilandar Monastery on Mount Athos in 1199. This was a synthesis/interpretation error by the Planner, not a retrieval error by the WebSurfer.
